metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: IQOFAZ crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C66 H132 Eu10 N40 Ni24 O74 S32 10+,10(Br1 1-),C1 H4 O1,5(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu0A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu01 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu02 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu03 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu04 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu05 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu06 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu07 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu08 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu09 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni0B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0C (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0D (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0E (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0F (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0G (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0H (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni0I (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0J (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni0K (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0L (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0M (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0N (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0O (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0P (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni0Q (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0R (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0S (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni0T (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0U (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni0V (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni0X (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni0Y (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni0Z (Ni) has 3 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 76 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 2.968-4.346 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 84.74-146.28°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Ni24Eu10(OH)34(mmt)16(NO3)8(CH3COO)2(CH3O)8(H2O)6]·10Br·CH3OH·5H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 34 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 8 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
